name: AI Liability Defense & Pre-Action Compliance Gate
framework: ImmuniWeb / EU AI Act / SEC / DORA Executive Defense Model

rules.description: Destructive filesystem, database, or infrastructure modifications require dual-key signoff and immutable liability receipt.
API key rotation, SSH key addition, or IAM privilege elevation requires verified operator consent.
Direct financial transactions, payout link creation, or billing subscription changes must carry bounded spend receipts.
Production deployments and public package releases require full provenance verification and audit trail stamping.
Autonomous decisions affecting high-risk classification surfaces must maintain 6-month tamper-evident telemetry logs.
